response: The "Treatment of Early Age Mania (TEAM)" sample does generalize to some extent, as only 7.8% of subjects from the Phenomenology study did not fit the RCT criteria. However, it's essential to note that the RCT subjects were more severely ill, which raises uncertainty about whether the treatment findings from the RCT can be applied to children with less severe mania. Therefore, while the sample has some generalizability, its applicability to less severe cases of child bipolar I disorder is unclear and requires further investigation.
